title: Renewal Missing-Information Notices — Days for Outside Medical Bills
content:
Outside medical bills still to be gathered lengthen the response days of a renewal's missing-information notice under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care). Days are added when the renewal's Riverbend claim alone does not establish the hardship share and no outside medical bills document has been logged as received on the renewal case, so that outside medical bills still to be gathered decide the test.

**Hardship share.** The tier's hardship medical debt percent (20.0 percent on the Riverbend Medical Hardship Assistance tier) of the annual household income recorded on the renewal case.

| Outside medical bills logged as received on the renewal case | Medical debt claimed on the renewal case | Days added |
|---|---|---|
| none | below 25 percent of the hardship share | 21 |
| none | at least 25 percent of the hardship share and at most the hardship share | 15 |
| none | above the hardship share | none |
| at least one | any | none |

**Hypothetical.** Recorded income 100,000.00 gives a hardship share of 20,000.00, a quarter of which is 5,000.00. A claim of 4,999.99 adds 21 days; a claim of 5,000.00 or of 20,000.00 adds 15 days; a claim of 20,000.01 adds none.
